dogecoin.text:
Crypto like DogeCoin and Bitcoin does not provide any utility besides a medium of exchange, whereas commodity biz provide a service in exchange for a currency.

They do hold their own set of properties that make them stand apart from Government issued currency.
#Bitcoin #doge

Comparing cryptocurrencies to commodity businesses doesn't make sense. The community is better served to compare crypto market caps and circulating currency supplies of countries as a comparison.
#cryptocurrency #Dogecoin #DogecoinRise
